query:
SELECT c.output_handle, c.transaction_id, c.dependencies,
                      c.fhe_operation, c.is_scalar, c.operand_boundary_mask,
                      c.is_completed, c.is_allowed, c.dependence_chain_id,
                      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM computations p
                              WHERE p.host_chain_id = c.host_chain_id
                                AND p.transaction_id = c.transaction_id
                                AND p.output_handle = $2) AS "local_input!",
                      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.drifted_handle d
                              WHERE d.consensus_epoch = $3 AND d.host_chain_id = c.host_chain_id
                                AND d.handle = c.output_handle AND d.healed_at IS NOT NULL) AS "healed!"
               FROM computations c
               WHERE c.host_chain_id = $1 AND c.dependencies @> ARRAY[$2]::bytea[]
